verdict.rationale: A skill is a plain directory containing a `SKILL.md` plus optional scripts and references. Codex scans `.agents/skills` on disk, so installed skill files are ordinary files a lead can read. Curated skills and plugins are published in public GitHub repos (openai/skills, openai/plugins, including manifest and companion-surface layout), so contents can be inspected manually before running `$skill-installer` or installing from the marketplace. However, nothing shows the installer or `/plugins` browser itself listing a skill's files, instructions, or scripts before install. Missing for 10: a built-in pre-install contents/diff preview in `$skill-installer` or the plugin browser, documentation of where installed plugin skill files land for post-install review, and hands-on corroboration of a review workflow.
